introduction.heading: Introduction
introduction.body: PassorMatch ("we," "us," "our," or "Company") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website and use our services.

infoCollect.heading: 1. Information We Collect

provided.account: Account information (name, email, phone, date of birth)
provided.payment: Payment information (processed securely by third-party providers)
provided.health: Health disclosures you choose to add to your profile (see "Health Disclosures" below)
provided.reports: Reports, blocks, and safety-related information you or others submit about your account

auto.device: Device information (IP address, device type, browser type)
auto.usage: Usage data (features accessed, time spent, actions taken)
auto.location: Location data, used to show your approximate distance to other users and to match you with people nearby (if you grant permission)
auto.analytics: App and website usage analytics, collected via Google Firebase Analytics — see "Analytics" below

infoCollect.analyticsBody1: We use Google Firebase Analytics to understand how the Service is used — for example, which screens are viewed, how often the app is opened, and general session activity. This is first-party product analytics: we use it to improve the Service and are not currently using it for ad personalization or cross-app/cross-device ad tracking. Firebase Analytics may collect your approximate location (derived from IP address, not precise GPS), device and app information, and an app-instance identifier. This data is processed by Google as our service provider and is not linked to your name or contact details in our analytics reporting.
infoCollect.analyticsBody2Strong: Your location is never shown to other users as an exact address or precise coordinate.
infoCollect.analyticsBody2Rest: Any distance or location shown to other users is approximate ("fuzzed" — for example, rounded to the nearest few kilometers or shown as a general area), not your exact position, and is not sufficient on its own to identify your precise home, workplace, or real-time location.

photos.heading: Photos & Profile Visibility
photos.body: Your profile photos, bio, and other profile details you choose to display are visible to other users of the Service as part of its core matching functionality. We may use automated tools and human review to screen uploaded photos and content for policy violations (e.g. nudity, impersonation, or illegal content) before or after they become visible to other users.

circles.heading: Sensitive Information & Community Groups ("Circles")
circles.body1: The Service lets you join optional interest- and identity-based community groups ("Circles"), some of which may reveal sensitive personal information about you — for example, your sexual orientation or gender identity (such as an LGBTQ+-oriented Circle), your religion (such as a Religion & Spirituality Circle), or your race or ethnicity (such as a race- or ethnicity-based Circle).
circles.body2Strong: We never share your membership in a sensitive Circle — or the fact that it reveals your sexual orientation, religion, race, or any similar sensitive category — with advertising partners, ad networks, or analytics/tracking partners.
circles.body2Rest: This information is used solely for in-app purposes: to show you relevant Circles, to power in-app matching and content within the Service, and for safety and moderation. It is never sold, and never used to build advertising profiles, whether by us or by any third party.
circles.body3: We also do not use your sensitive Circle membership to enrich or supplement location-based profiling of you — for example, we do not combine your Circle memberships with location data to infer or share more precise information about where you spend time.
circles.body4: You choose which Circles to join, and you may leave a Circle at any time; leaving removes it from your visible memberships going forward.

health.heading: Health Disclosures
health.body1: As part of completing your profile, you may optionally share a health disclosure — for example, a sexual health condition, mental health condition, ADHD, autism, a long-term physical condition, or that you are in substance use recovery. This is entirely optional and is only visible on your profile if you choose to add it.
health.body2Strong: Because a health disclosure you add is shown on your profile, it is visible to other users of the Service
health.body2Rest: in the same way as your other profile information (see "Photos & Profile Visibility" above). We do not share your health disclosure with advertising partners, ad networks, or analytics/tracking partners, and it is never used to build advertising profiles or sold to third parties.
health.body3: You may add, change, or remove your health disclosure at any time in your profile settings.

howWeUse.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information

items.marketing: Marketing and promotional purposes (with your consent)

howWeUse.scanningRest: To detect violations of our Acceptable Use Policy — such as harassment, scams, explicit or illegal content, and other safety risks — content and messages you post or send through the Service may be automatically scanned using third-party moderation tools. This scanning is used for trust and safety purposes only, is not used for advertising, and does not replace your ability to report content or users directly.

sharing.heading: 3. Data Sharing & Disclosure
sharing.intro: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with:

items.lawEnforcement: Law enforcement (when legally required, including in response to safety reports involving harassment, threats, or suspected criminal activity)
items.otherUsers: Other users (profile information you choose to display, and limited details in connection with a report you file or that is filed against you)

sharing.exceptionStrong: Exception for sensitive Circle membership and health disclosures:
sharing.exceptionRest: As described in "Sensitive Information & Community Groups" and "Health Disclosures" above, your membership in a Circle that reveals sexual orientation, religion, race, or a similar sensitive category, and any health disclosure you add to your profile, are never shared with our advertising or analytics service providers, and are excluded from the analytics sharing described above.

security.heading: 4. Data Security
security.body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information, including encryption, secure servers, and access controls. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

retention.heading: 5. Data Retention
retention.intro: When you delete your account, we delete your account data within 30 days, except for data we are required or permitted to retain longer for:

items.safety: Safety purposes (e.g. records related to reports, blocks, bans, or safety investigations, to prevent banned users from rejoining)
items.legal: Legal obligations (e.g. tax, accounting, or regulatory recordkeeping requirements)
items.fraud: Fraud prevention (e.g. information needed to detect and prevent fraudulent accounts or payments)

retention.outro: Data retained for these purposes is kept only as long as necessary for that purpose and is subject to the same security protections described above.

rights.heading: 6. Your Privacy Rights
rights.intro: Depending on your location, you may have the right to:
rights.withdrawStrong: Withdrawing your consent to gender-based matching:
rights.withdrawRest: At signup, you separately agree to let us use your gender to show you and other users relevant matches. Because gender-based matching is core to how the Service works, the way to withdraw this consent is to delete your account in Settings — this immediately stops all matching and removes your profile from other users' view. We do not currently offer a way to keep an active account while opting out of matching alone.
rights.thailandBody: If you are located in Thailand, we process your personal data as a data controller under the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019). In addition to the rights above, you have the right to withdraw consent at any time (where processing is based on consent), the right to object to processing, and the right to lodge a complaint with the Personal Data Protection Committee (PDPC). Sensitive data under the PDPA (which includes data revealing sexual orientation and religion, such as certain Circle memberships described above, and health data, such as an optional health disclosure you add to your profile) is processed only with your explicit consent or another legal basis permitted under the PDPA, and is handled with the heightened protections the PDPA requires.
rights.gdprBody: If you are located in the EEA or UK, we process your personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) / UK GDPR. Our legal bases for processing include your consent, performance of our contract with you (providing the Service), our legitimate interests (such as safety and fraud prevention), and compliance with legal obligations. You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, or port your data, to object to processing (including profiling), to withdraw consent at any time, and to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority. Special category data (including data revealing sexual orientation and religion, and health data such as an optional health disclosure you add to your profile) is processed only where a valid GDPR condition applies, such as your explicit consent.
rights.ccpaHeading: United States — CCPA/CPRA and other state privacy laws
rights.ccpaBody: If you are a California resident, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), as amended by the CPRA, and other applicable U.S. state privacy laws give you the right to know what personal information we collect, use, and disclose; to request deletion or correction of your information; to opt out of the "sale" or "sharing" of personal information (we do not sell your personal information, and do not share sensitive Circle membership or health disclosures with advertising or analytics partners as described above); and to not be discriminated against for exercising these rights. Sensitive personal information under the CCPA — which includes data revealing sexual orientation and religious beliefs, and health information such as an optional health disclosure you add to your profile — is used only as necessary to provide the Service and is not used to infer characteristics about you for advertising purposes.
rights.exerciseRights: To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details in the "Contact Us" section below. We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling a request.

cookies.heading: 7. Cookies & Tracking
cookies.body: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience, analyze usage, and personalize content. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.

children.heading: 8. Children's Privacy
children.body: PassorMatch is strictly for users 18 years of age and older. It is not intended for, and may not be used by, anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If we become aware that we have collected personal data from someone under 18, we will take steps to delete it promptly and, where applicable, terminate the associated account.

contact.heading: 9. Contact Us
contact.intro: If you have privacy concerns or requests, please contact us at:

changes.heading: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last updated" date. Your continued use of our services indicates acceptance of the revised policy.

cta.subheading: Our support team is here to help

ageAssurance.heading: Age Assurance and Biometric Data
ageAssurance.body1: In certain regions where the law requires it, after you set up your profile we may ask you to verify that you are 18 or over in order to keep using PassorMatch. You are given a limited grace period to complete this. This may involve a short selfie so an age can be estimated from your facial image.
ageAssurance.body2: When you complete this check, your facial image is processed only to estimate your age and confirm a real, live person is present. As part of the same check, and only if you have a profile photo, your selfie may also be compared to that photo to confirm it is really you — this powers an optional "Verified" badge on your profile. If the check passes, your image is deleted immediately. If it does not pass, we keep only your most recent unsuccessful image for up to 7 days, solely so that our support team can review it if you believe you were wrongly declined and ask us to check again; after that period it is automatically and permanently deleted. In all cases we do not create or store a face template or face profile, and your image is never used for advertising or any other purpose. We retain only the outcome of the check (for example, whether it passed, and whether the photo matched) and, where relevant, the estimated age range.
ageAssurance.body3: This processing is carried out using Amazon Rekognition (Amazon Web Services) acting as our processor. Where this data is treated as biometric or special-category data under applicable law, we process it to comply with our legal obligations to keep minors off the service and, where required, on the basis of your consent, which you may decline (in which case we may be unable to offer the service to you in that region). The optional selfie-to-photo comparison is used only to award the "Verified" badge; it never affects your access to PassorMatch, and if the photos do not match you are not restricted in any way.

support.body: For any questions, issues, or feedback about PassorMatch, please reach out to us by email and our team will get back to you as soon as possible.

accounts.heading: 3. User Accounts
accounts.intro: When you create an account on PassorMatch, you must:

items.age: Be at least 18 years of age — PassorMatch is strictly for adults 18 and older, with no exceptions, and we do not permit accounts for anyone under 18
items.confidentiality: Maintain the confidentiality of your password
items.responsibility: Accept responsibility for all activities under your account
items.oneAccount: Create only one account for your own personal use — accounts may not be shared, sold, or transferred

noGuarantee.heading: 4. No Guarantee of Matches or Compatibility
noGuarantee.body: PassorMatch is a platform that helps you connect with other users; it is not a matchmaking, background-check, or dating-coaching service. We do not guarantee that you will find a match, that any match will be compatible with you, or that any interaction with another user will be safe, truthful, or appropriate. You are solely responsible for your interactions with other users, both on and off the Service.

acceptableUse.heading: 5. Acceptable Use Policy
acceptableUse.intro: You agree not to use PassorMatch to:

items.harass: Harass, abuse, or threaten other users
items.false: Post false, misleading, or fraudulent information
items.impersonate: Impersonate any person, or create a profile using another person's photos or identity ("catfishing")
items.exploitation: Engage in sexual exploitation or trafficking
items.spam: Spam, scam, or phishing attempts, including requests for money, gift cards, or financial information from other users
items.unauthorized: Attempt to gain unauthorized access to our systems
items.explicit: Post explicit, nude, or illegal content, or content involving minors
items.solicit: Solicit or advertise commercial services, including sex work, to other users

safety.heading: 6. Dating Safety & In-Person Meetings
safety.intro: PassorMatch does not conduct criminal background checks on its users and cannot verify the identity, intentions, or truthfulness of any user. You are responsible for exercising your own judgment and caution when communicating with other users and when deciding whether to meet someone in person. We strongly recommend that you:

items.money: Never send money, gift cards, or financial information to someone you have not met in person
items.publicPlace: Meet for the first time in a public place, and arrange your own transportation
items.tellSomeone: Tell a friend or family member where you are going and who you are meeting
items.avoidSharing: Avoid sharing sensitive personal information (home address, financial details, workplace) until you have established trust
items.trustInstincts: Trust your instincts and end contact with anyone who makes you feel unsafe or uncomfortable

safety.outro: PassorMatch is not responsible for the conduct of any user, whether online or in person, and disclaims all liability for any interactions, meetings, or relationships arising from use of the Service, to the fullest extent permitted by law.

reporting.heading: 7. Reporting, Blocking & Enforcement
reporting.body: PassorMatch provides tools to block and report other users. If you encounter behavior that violates these Terms — including harassment, fraud, impersonation, or inappropriate content — please report it through the in-app reporting feature or by contacting us directly. We reserve the right, at our sole discretion, to investigate reports, remove content, and suspend or permanently terminate any account that violates these Terms, without prior notice and without refund of any paid features.

content.body: You retain ownership of content you post, but grant PassorMatch a worldwide, non-exclusive license to use, reproduce, and display your profile information for operating the Service. By posting content, you warrant that you own or have permission to use such content, that any photos are genuinely of you, and that your content does not depict any other identifiable person without their consent.

ageVerification.heading: Age Verification
ageVerification.body: Because PassorMatch is strictly for adults 18 and over, in certain regions you may be required to verify your age after you complete your profile. You are given a limited grace period to do so, during which you can keep using the service. This may include a facial age check. If age verification is required and you do not complete it before the grace period ends, or it does not confirm that you are 18 or over, we may limit, suspend, or terminate your access. If a check does not pass and you believe you were wrongly declined, you can contact support to have it reviewed; to make this possible we keep your most recent unsuccessful image for a short period (up to 7 days) before it is automatically deleted. As part of the same check we may also compare your selfie to your profile photo to award an optional "Verified" badge; this comparison is purely for the badge and never limits, suspends, or affects your access, whether or not the photos match. Verification is handled as described in our Privacy Policy.

commitment.heading: Our Commitment
commitment.body: PassorMatch is an adults-only (18+) dating and social platform. We have a zero-tolerance policy toward child sexual abuse and exploitation (CSAE) and child sexual abuse material (CSAM). The safety of minors is a top priority, and we are committed to preventing, detecting, and responding to any content or behavior that endangers children. This page describes the standards and measures we maintain in line with Google Play’s Child Safety Standards policy.

adults.heading: Adults Only — 18+
adults.body: PassorMatch is strictly for adults aged 18 and over. Minors are not permitted to create an account or use the service. We enforce a minimum age of 18 through the following measures:
items: During registration, every user must provide a date of birth. Anyone whose date of birth indicates they are under 18 is prevented from completing sign-up.
Our backend independently checks the date of birth and rejects any account for a user under 18, so the age requirement is enforced on the server and not only in the app.
Our automated moderation systems scan profile content for indications that a user may be a minor (for example, self-disclosure of being underage), and flag such accounts for human review and removal.

In regions whose law requires it, once a user has set up their profile we ask them to verify that they are 18 or over through a facial age-estimation check, within a limited grace period, in order to keep using the service. This check is provided by a third-party facial-analysis service, includes a liveness check to deter spoofing, and processes the image only to estimate age — the image is deleted immediately afterwards. Where a region legally requires identity-document based verification that we do not yet support, we do not offer the service there.

prohibited.heading: Prohibited Content and Conduct
prohibited.body: The following are strictly prohibited on PassorMatch. Any of these will result in immediate removal and account termination:
items: Any child sexual abuse material (CSAM) or content that sexualizes minors.
Grooming, solicitation, or any attempt to contact, exploit, or endanger a minor.
Use of the service by anyone under the age of 18.
Sharing, requesting, or facilitating access to any content that depicts the abuse or exploitation of a child.

detection.heading: Detection and Moderation
detection.body: We operate automated and human moderation systems designed to detect and act on child-safety risks:
items: Automated content moderation scans profile information and reviews reported content for prohibited material and signals of underage use, classifying and prioritizing high-severity cases.
Flagged cases are escalated to a moderation team through an internal review dashboard, where child-safety and underage cases are treated as the highest priority.
Accounts found to violate these standards are removed, and associated content is deleted.

reporting.heading: In-App Reporting
reporting.body: Every user can report other users and content directly from within the app. Reports that relate to child safety are prioritized for urgent review. To report a concern:
steps: Open the profile or conversation in question.
Select the menu and choose Report.
Choose the reason that best describes the concern and submit.
reporting.emailNote: You can also report a child-safety concern at any time by emailing us at <email></email>.

authorities.heading: Reporting to Authorities
authorities.body: We comply with all applicable child-safety laws. When we become aware of apparent child sexual abuse material or the exploitation of a minor, we act to remove it and report it to the appropriate regional and national authorities, including relevant child-protection organizations and law enforcement (such as the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, NCMEC, where applicable), in accordance with our legal obligations.
